HomePage.FirstParagraph:
Hello! My name is Semyon. I am 
a programmer, but in my spare time I do ceramics: I make various ceramic items and experiment with glazes.
HomePage.SecondParagraph: You can buy something for yourself or as a gift by contacting me through social networks.

SegerBlock.Title: Helping the Ceramists
SegerBlock.FirstParagraph: «Seger» —  a notebook for ceramicists and potters who make their own glazes
SegerBlock.SecondParagraph: I took a direct part in the creation of Seger, thus combining the main directions of my activity: programming and ceramics.
